svg.aria-label: Notification system design. 1 Services 1 to N call the notification servers, which handle authentication, rate limiting and validation; 2 the servers read users, devices, settings and templates from a cache and database; 3 they put each notification on a queue for its channel (iOS push, Android push, SMS, email); 4 workers pull from the queues; 5 workers call the providers APNs, FCM, Twilio and SendGrid; 6 the providers deliver to the user's devices. Workers persist every notification to a notification log so failures can be retried, and delivery events flow to an analytics service.
svg.title: Notification system architecture
